title: EU Climate & Energy Daily Briefing
subtitle: Friday, 5 June 2026 — Key developments from the last 24 hours

highlights.headline: Commission approves €100 million Austrian State aid scheme to support cleantech manufacturing capacity
highlights.summary: European Commission Press release Brussels, 05 Jun 2026 The European Commission has approved a €100 million Austrian scheme to support clean technology ('cleantech') manufacturing capacity, in line with the objectives of the Clean Industrial Deal. This measure will contribute to the transition towards a net-zero economy. The scheme was approved under the Clean Industrial Deal State Aid Framework (CISAF) adopted by the Commission on 25 June 2025.

items.title: North Korea quietly ramps up its nuclear program
